description: Change an existing prompt. `name` must be the exact title or the id. Only the fields you pass are touched; a field you leave out is NOT changed, a field you pass OVERWRITES. `content` (the full new text) is saved as a NEW version: the old version is kept and nothing is deleted; content equal to the current version creates no version. bump: patch (default), minor or major. `description` (one line; '' clears it) overwrites the prompt's description. `tags` ADDS tags: the ones the prompt lacks are added; tags already on it, and tags you do not list, are left as they are. It never removes a tag ([] changes nothing; remove a tag in the web app). Description and tags are not part of a version: changing only them never creates one, and the previous description is returned so it can be restored. Pass at least one of content, description, tags; passing values that already match changes nothing. This tool never deletes a prompt, a version or a tag.

bump.description: Semver bump of the new version (default patch; only with content)

changelog.description: What changed in the new version, one line (only with content)

content.description: The full new prompt text (a new version). Omit to leave the text and versions untouched

description.description: One-line description. Omit to leave it unchanged; given (even '') it overwrites

name.description: Exact prompt title, or its id / short id

project.description: Repo name, slug, or id when titles collide

tags.description: Tags to ADD (add-only: tags already on the prompt, or not listed, are never removed; [] changes nothing). Omit to leave tags unchanged

name: update_prompt
title: Update a prompt (new version, description, tags)
